issues.title: Direct-array list outputs are not envelope-shaped yet
issues.reason: Changing these tools from direct arrays to objects would be a wire-shape breaking change.
issues.next_round: Design a compatibility migration using compat_mode or versioned tools before implementation.

issues.title: List total is returned-count, not full backend count
issues.reason: Current service methods return slices without a full-count field.
issues.next_round: Add service-level count/has_more support where the store can provide it.

issues.title: Truncated is inferred from limit and returned length
issues.reason: Without backend has_more, limit reached means possible truncation, not a proven full-count comparison.
issues.next_round: Replace inference with backend has_more when pagination metadata exists.
